title: Jamaican Coconut Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with Jamaican spices and coconut milk.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add Jamaican curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add cubed sweet potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Add shredded carrots and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let the stew cook for 20-25 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
